messages.subject: trouble with year effects in colext
parts:
Greetings all,

I have been having trouble fitting yearly site covariates within the colext dynamic occupancy model.  I have been following the crossbill example from a workshop handout by M. Kery (March 2012) that I found online, and keeping getting the following error when I try to fit 'year' as a factor affect gamma and epsilon.

Error in `contrasts<-`(`*tmp*`, value = contr.funs[1 + isOF[nn]]) : 
  contrasts can be applied only to factors with 2 or more levels

Below is the summary of my unmarkedMultFrame which appears to be formatted similarly to the crossbill data example.

Is the presence of a number of NAs potentially causing this issue?  I had to add these to make the dimensions of the matrices equal as I had unequal numbers of surveys for each sampling period.  I saw that missing yearlysitecovs was still a potential bug- I don't have any missing values in those two vectors, but do in the y matrix.  The actual code I'm running is below in terms of the dataframe and model is as follows:

years <- as.character(2012:2013)
years <- matrix(years, nrow(aa.count), 2, byrow=TRUE)

##AMAN multiseason occupancy
umf <- unmarkedMultFrame(y=aa.count[,c(2:19)],
          siteCovs=site.covs[,c(6,13:17)], yearlySiteCovs=list(year=years),                                                                                          
          obsCovs=list(date=date[,c(1:9,18:26)],temp=temp[,c(1:9,18:26)],method=as.matrix(method[c(2:10,19:27)])),numPrimary=2)
mod9<-colext(~Fish+canopy1+Open1+PerForest1+Area1,~year,~year,~date+temp+method,umf)

Any thoughts would be greatly appreciated. 

Tom

messages.subject: RE: [unmarked] trouble with year effects in colext
parts:
Dear Thomas,

I just tried to fit dynamic occupancy models to a subset of the crossbill data with two years only and got the same errors:

> fm1 <- colext(~ 1, ~ year, ~year, ~year, umf)
Fehler in `contrasts<-`(`*tmp*`, value = contr.funs[1 + isOF[nn]]) :
contrasts can be applied only to factors with 2 or more levels

Timing stopped at: 0.02 0 0.02

> fm1 <- colext(~ 1, ~ year-1, ~year-1, ~year-1, umf)
Fehler in `contrasts<-`(`*tmp*`, value = contr.funs[1 + isOF[nn]]) :
contrasts can be applied only to factors with 2 or more levels

I have never tried to fit dynamic occupancy models using colext for two primary periods only. I wonder whether this is a bug ?

Kind regards  --  Marc

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: RE: [unmarked] trouble with year effects in colext
parts:
Hi Chris,

you are absolutely right !

Yes, with two years, there is a single interval, so the colonisation and extinction parameters cannot be modelled as year-specific. So, as you say, they should be kept as '~ 1' (or else modelled by site-specific covariates)

However, it should be possible to make detection probability year-specific.

Kind regards  ---  Marc
